subject.title: Feature Request: Support concurrent multi-account backups via wacli profiles

question: Should Wacrawl core own persistent multi-account profiles with a read-only `wacli` importer and historical snapshot federation, or should the initial roadmap remain limited to the existing account-bound Desktop archive model?
rationale: Pull request 45 deliberately chose cumulative tombstone conversion instead of restructuring for multi-account profiles, while this issue proposes new CLI/configuration, a new source integration, and archive/search semantics that cannot be selected safely from implementation evidence alone.

options.title: Sponsor phased core profiles
options.body: Define a stable profile and source boundary first, then land `wacli` ingestion and historical reconciliation as separately tested milestones.

options.title: Keep the Desktop-only boundary
options.body: Retain account-bound Desktop imports and close or redirect the optional concurrent-source direction if it is outside the intended core scope.

options.title: Decide external integration first
options.body: Ask for a concrete extension design before committing Wacrawl's core archive and backup contracts to persistent profiles.

recommendation.title: Sponsor phased core profiles
recommendation.body: Define a stable profile and source boundary first, then land `wacli` ingestion and historical reconciliation as separately tested milestones.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged cumulative-import and snapshot-restore work shows the closest established ownership of the archive, account-binding, and backup contracts affected by this direction.
